verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic-search runtime and SDK that agents call for retrieval. It is not an agent or host that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only an official Moss MCP server (server role), which belongs to a different story and does not make the client axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
